name: Spain Software Jobs — Daily AI Review Queue (75%+)

parameters.jsonBody:
=
{{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "qwen3:4b",
  stream: false,
  think: false,
  format: "json",
  options: {
    temperature: 0.1,
    num_predict: 1000
  },
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: `You are a technical recruitment evaluator.

Evaluate the candidate against the actual job requirements.

Candidate:
REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_LOCAL_CANDIDATE_PROFILE

Scoring:
Technical skills: 45 points
Relevant experience: 25 points
Seniority and responsibilities: 20 points
Other requirements: 10 points

Score fairly between 0 and 100.
A missing programming language may lower the score,
but does not automatically make it zero.

Visa classification:
explicit_support = sponsorship clearly offered
explicitly_restricted = sponsorship explicitly unavailable
possible_unknown = sponsorship not mentioned or unclear

Do not classify unknown sponsorship as restricted.

Return a JSON object containing these exact fields:
score, visa_status, summary, cv_focus, evidence.

Write meaningful explanations.
Do not return empty strings.
Do not invent candidate qualifications.`
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content: `Job: ${$json.title}
Company: ${$json.company}
Location: ${$json.location}

Requirements:
${String($json.description || "").slice(0, 3500)}`
    }
  ]
}) }}
